# Best noise-cancelling headphones under $100

**Top pick: Soundcore Space One (about $100, or $80 with a code)**
- Best Products ranks it best overall under $100. It has adaptive ANC, rotating ear cups, a good app with EQ, and a 55-hour battery with ANC off ([Best Products](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g61501080/cheap-noise-canceling-headphones-under-100/)).
- Dealectric lists it at $99.99, and code AFSC20 brings it to $80. They tested the code on 2026-10-22, and it expires 2026-12-31. The code excludes items already on sale ([Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/answers/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-100-2026-reviews-prices)).
- Downsides: it's heavier than some rivals, has no sweat resistance, and LDAC doesn't work while two devices are connected.
- **Buy:** [Soundcore Space One](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-space-one). This is an affiliate link, so Dealectric is paid if you buy, at no cost to you.

**Other good options**
- **Soundcore Space Q45 (around $99):** RTINGS' best budget pick for noise isolation, which handles engine rumble and chatty coworkers well. Measured battery is 28 hours, and some owners report headband cracks ([RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones)).
- **Soundcore Life Q30 (under $100):** RTINGS' top over-ear under $100, with strong ANC and about 44 hours of battery. It leaks some sound ([RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/over-ear-headphones-under-100)).
- **Soundcore Life Q20 2024 (cheaper):** Nearly matches the Q45's isolation, with 49 hours of battery. The build feels plasticky and the earpads can flake ([RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones)).
- **Sony WH-CH720N ($99):** Very light at 192 g, but it only supports SBC and AAC ([CartIQ](https://www.cartiq.net/us/electronics/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-100/)).
- **Edifier Atom Max (about $45):** The best-value pick at the low end. Its hybrid ANC is rated at up to 44 dB, and it has no 3.5mm jack ([Best Products](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g61501080/cheap-noise-canceling-headphones-under-100/)).
- **1More SonoFlow (budget):** TechRadar's pick for best under $100 ([TechRadar](https://www.techradar.com/audio/headphones/best-noise-cancelling-headphones)). CartIQ lists the SE version at $65 with weaker ANC ([CartIQ](https://www.cartiq.net/us/electronics/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-100/)).
- **JBL Tune 760NC (about $79):** Bass-heavy sound, but its ANC is only so-so and it can feel tight on larger heads ([RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/over-ear-headphones-under-100)).

**Things to know**
- Prices change often, so check the current price before buying.
- Battery claims vary between sources. CartIQ says the Q45 lasts 50 hours with ANC off, while RTINGS measured 28 hours in testing.
- The sources I had were review pages, not direct product pages. For everything except the Space One, use the retailer buttons on the linked review pages.

If you tell me whether you care most about ANC strength, comfort, battery, or call quality, I can narrow this to one pick.
